invariants: Admin denial precedes JSON parsing, provider access, and persistence for every operation.
Execute and reconcile parse request bodies manually and never expose FastAPI 422 validation.
A newly reserved execution returns 202 and x-etk-job-id; an idempotent replay returns 200.
Reconciliation performs authoritative readback only and reports external_mutations_executed as zero.
Record deletion removes only the local record and filesystem-cache rows; it never calls a 115 delete provider.
Deleting a missing record is idempotent and preserves the legacy 200 success envelope.
limitations: Provider and persistence behavior is exercised with local fakes or isolated repository contracts only.
Real 115 mutation and PostgreSQL acceptance remain HUMAN_PENDING.
